Kdenlive. Free, has been around since 2010(?), and is very easy and straightforward to use. Does a fantastic job with basic projects.
It is going from strength to strength, and has become a brilliant piece of software.

Open shot and kdenlive both have much better user interfaces and I find easier to use, but they are lacking a lot of the features you find in premier, vegas, etc
Shotcut. A little counter-intuitive but it's the best non-linear editor for very basic editing. Other software offers more but this one meets my needs the best.
